question: Pit Spawn has first strike and exiles any creature it damages. Can it exile a creature before that creature deals combat damage back?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: it often deals first-strike damage and exiles the creature before it can deal damage back.
expected.answer: Since this card has First Strike it will often deal damage during first strike damage dealing and its ability will exile the creature it damages before that creature can deal damage back.
